title: Hex on command
description: Hex on command adds a single command, /hexcastinggui, which only works if the player using the command has the attribute hexoncommand:command_permission set to 1.
body:
![Demonstration](https://i.imgur.com/uEwDoty.gif)

An addon for the [Hexcasting mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/hex-casting)

Adds a single command intended for use in datapacks alongside one attribute `hexoncommand:command_permission`

Example usage:

```
/attribute @p hexoncommand:command_permission base set 1
/hexcastinggui
```

A [datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/origins-x-hexcasting-origin-freecaster) exists for use with the [Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins) mod, adding a simple example origin to show users how this mod may be used effectively.

I intend to add these features eventually:
- A command to cast via chat (Will also require a permission)
/hexcast <HexPattern> <HexPattern> ... <HexPattern>
- Better configuration, to optionally allow the command to be used without any attributes

Update: For the ability to cast via command, please consider using this addon by Teekas: https://modrinth.com/mod/teekaspaste
